+title: Set ElicitationRequest.source to the server name for an MCP server question
+---
+Today a question that an MCP server sends (elicitation/create) reaches the client with ElicitationRequest.source = "runCode". ACPAgent sends `source` to the client, thus the user sees "runCode" and not the server that asks.
+
+Do:
+- In the MCP elicitation path (MCPServer+Elicitation.swift), set ElicitationRequest.source to the name of the MCP server that sent the question.
+- A fixed-order test with ScriptedElicitationSink: an MCP server question reaches the sink with source = the server name.
+- Do not change the source of a sandbox elicit() question.
+
+Batch with ^gsk0jv8 in one push. Owner request from the coordinating session, 2026-10-16. #elicitation-phase-3
\ No newline at end of file
